A '''poison gas grenade''', also called simply a '''poison grenade''', was a type of [[Gas grenade/Legends|gas grenade]] that, when detonated, expelled a type of [[Poison/Legends|poison]] that [[Death/Legends|killed]] or harmed anyone within its four-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] blast radius. The poison was expelled in a gaseous state.<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], poison gas grenades were used by some [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunters]]. The grenades were filled with gases such as [[Dioxis/Legends|dioxis]] and [[Trion/Legends|trion gas]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
